pages.text: The $(thing)Mana Pool$() is a basin carved from $(thing)Living Rock$() that holds up to one million units of mana. Mystical flowers planted nearby will automatically push their generated mana into the nearest pool within 6 blocks.
A $(thing)Redstone Comparator$() placed next to a Mana Pool will output a signal proportional to how full the pool is — 0 when empty, up to 15 when completely full.
